title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: PLAC — Christ parallel: loco punishment frees us; so Adam's loco original would free us too
pass_a_gloss: Christ-parallel cuts hard: we sin in our own persons yet need not be punished again because Christ was punished loco. So if Adam was already punished loco by having original sin inflicted for his actual sin, original cannot again be inflicted on us for that same act.
pass_b_english: For just as, though we ourselves have sinned in our own persons, yet because Christ was punished in our place we ought not to be punished further: so if for that actual sin Adam was punished in our place by the infliction of original sin, original sin can no longer be inflicted on us for that same sin.
source_text: Sicut enim quamvis ipsi in propriis nostris personis peccaverimus, tamen quia Christus loco nostro punitus est, non debemus amplius puniri: ita si pro illo peccato actuali punitus est Adamus loco nostro inflictione peccati originalis, non potest amplius pro eodem illo peccato nobis peccatum originale infligi.

choices.choice: Loco punishment frees; so Adam's would free us
